scope.purpose: Extract released-MARS evidence for the original pair and up to five outcome-blind strictly prior exact-grid Sentinel-2 references.
scope.sensor_policy: Sentinel-2 receives selected alternate references; Landsat and uncovered Sentinel-2 rows use the original pair exactly.

tests.result: 9 focused extraction, adjudication, and reference-bank tests passed before the real smoke

reference_substitution.reference: selected prior sample first six target bands; never its background bands
reference_substitution.wind: unchanged original target row wind_u and wind_v divided by 8
reference_substitution.cloud_channel: unchanged original target cloud mask; the selected reference is already constrained to >=95% clear by the frozen selector
reference_substitution.score_mask: released probability is zeroed only where the original target cloud class is nonzero, exactly matching the existing released-score cache
reference_substitution.fallback: original pair exactly when no selected reference exists

released_model.scene_score: 8-connected-component threshold for at least 100 pixels, matching the released paper implementation

view_order: five selector-ordered prior references padded by masked original-reference copies
representation.pooled_maps: 32x32 adaptive mean and max pools of cloud-masked released probability
representation.purpose: Support a fixed aggregation diagnostic and, only after a pass, a small reference-set temporal model without rerunning the frozen released U-Net.

original_view_parity.comparator: released_connected_score from the frozen folds-2/3/4 scene-feature cache, aligned by unique sample_id
original_view_parity.failure_action: delete temporary outputs and stop before any alternate-reference result is accepted

smoke.selection: first two Sentinel-2 rows with five references, first Sentinel-2 fallback, and first Landsat fallback; outcome-blind

invariants: The extractor stores no label, plume mask, enhancement, champion score, official-test value, or external outcome.
Only folds 3/4 are materialized and output alignment is by unique sample_id.
Candidate reference IDs and order are frozen by the outcome-blind selector; methane-sensitive bands did not influence selection.
Only the original target image, selected candidate image, original target cloud mask, and non-outcome wind metadata are read.
Bulk maps and scores remain ignored; only the compact receipt may be committed.
This extraction cannot select a reference aggregation, train a model, set a threshold, or claim improvement.
claim_boundary: A successful extraction establishes only numerically faithful label-free evidence for frozen alternate references. Complementarity, performance, calibration, and superiority remain untested.
